business_summary: Hindustan Adhesives Limited, a specialty adhesive coating company, manufactures and sells self-adhesive tapes in India and internationally. It offers packaging tapes, which includes BOPP acrylic, BOPP hot melt, BOPP solvent, semi-crepe paper, water activated paper, recycled PET tapes, water activated, kraft paper, cellophane, and flexo printable tapes; industrial tapes, including double sided, filament, duct, aluminium foil, and masking tapes; tear tapes, such as carton, FMCG, and sustainable tear tapes, as well as string and tag tape for tea bags; and POF shrink films, comprising non-cross linked, cross-linked, and sustainable POF shrink films. The company also exports its products. Hindustan Adhesives Limited was incorporated in 1988 and is based in New Delhi, India.
